allowed_modes.keys: Return only the immediate key names of one addressed object.
allowed_modes.length: Return only the element count of one addressed array.
allowed_modes.scalar: Return one addressed non-container value of at most 4096 encoded bytes.

protocol: The access-control commit precedes every guarded-record read.
The sizing commit and expectations-only freeze precede every observed-value read.
Only field_reader.py may read the guarded JSON record.
Every invocation appends an audit row before it returns or prints a projection.
Rejected production requests stop the study and enter the forbidden-access ledger.
The prose result record is never read because it has no field-addressed interface.
No VLLM-41 observed value participates in predictor derivation or band construction.
Held-out successor cells are first compared only after non-held-out results are published.
